plannerPolicyComparison.measurementNotes: Diagnostic elapsed time includes local capture writing and failed attempts. Provider cost sums are reported usage, not application billing. The five-sample comparisons do not establish a population accuracy rate.

requestControlsEvidence.limitation: Clean source, the selected Runtime process, the owner request-assembly test and real provider acceptance establish the configured route. Sensitive captures did not record outbound model/reasoning controls or a separate reasoning-token count; this is not direct wire capture.

failure.case: explicit disjunction across public affiliation and PR evidence
failure.description: The provider produced a union-shaped identity output that failed the requirement to deliver the stored account.id field directly. The failed candidate was not executed.

plannerPolicyComparison.decision: Retain the default none planner policy. Medium showed no demonstrated accuracy gain in these samples and increased latency and reported provider cost. Preserve the earlier 13/14 none service result and the candidate 14/14 service result as separate observations.
